newsitem.title: USA: IBM has no comment on profit warning rumor.
newsitem.headline: IBM has no comment on profit warning rumor.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp said Wednesday it has no comment on rumors that the company is on the verge of issuing a profits warning and said it has no plans to issue a press release today.
"We have no plans to issue any press release today," a company spokesman told Reuters in response to a question.

The spokesman said that the company has no comment on rumors that have been circulating in Europe that IBM could issue a profit warning as early as today. IBM shares traded lower in London this morning, and the rumors sent a chill across the U.S. technology group ahead of the opening.
In New York preopening trade, shares of IBM were down 2-3/4 at 155-1/4. Earlier, in London the stock slid two.

Meanwhile, traders were watching for any comment from IBM Chairman Louis Gerstner, who was scheduled to begin speaking at a trade show in New York at 0845 EST/1345 GMT Wednesday. Gerstner was slated to give the keynote address at the Internet World conference.
